Criterion: Symptomatic patients with recent neurological events (TIA or non-disabling stroke) with an associated carotid stenosis greater than or equal to 50% by angiography or greater than or equal to 70% by ultrasound or greater than or equal to 70% by CTA or MRA are eligible for randomization.
Justification: No data provided on neurological events (TIA/stroke) or carotid stenosis measurements (angiography, ultrasound, CTA/MRA).
